text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager (sev2) — multi-GPU collective failures on tp4 cluster. See runbook `collective-comm`. Auto-invoked on-call: eng-runtime and eng-sre.

maya: seeing repeated NCCL communicator timeouts + CUDA Xid 79 on several TP workers. Containers flapping (OOM/crash/restart). Production inference path 'search-route' seeing elevated 503s. Needs immediate mitigation.

samir: i'm on it, pinging infra and runtime. taking first look.

eng-runtime-bot: alert: /var/log/runtime/nccl.log excerpt: ```[2026-03-15T02:08:47Z] ERROR NCCL_COMM 0x3 timeout rank 5 peer 7 op ALLREDUCE dur 12000ms
[2026-03-15T02:08:47Z] CUDA ERROR: Xid 79 -- GPU HANG detected, killing container pid 2418
[2026-03-15T02:08:48Z] container restart count: 3```

maya: affected nodes: tp4-node-08,tp4-node-09,tp4-node-12. All are running tp4 topology for model shard. Memory on GPU isn't maxed but kernel reports page faults then hang. Containers show exit code 137/Signal 7 sometimes.

dasha: infra oncall — copying logs, grabbing kernel/dmesg for those hosts. any immediate mitigation we want?

ashwin: taking pager. immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain tp4-node-08 (most noisy) 2) enable NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 on pool as quick failover 3) reroute traffic to single-gpu fallback model (v1-small) for latency-sensitive routes 4) collect full kernel trace + nvidia-smi nvlink stats. I'll coordinate.

lee: FYI customer impact: enterprise-corp is seeing ~5% failed inferences and 2–3x latency on batched routes. Support ticket #INC-12345 opened.

maya: executing drain on tp4-node-08 now
```bash
kubectl cordon node/tp4-node-08
kubectl drain node/tp4-node-08 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
```

eng-runtime-bot: action: scaled down multi-gpu pool + reconfigured env on canary replicas: `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1` applied. Cache/kv disabled for affected flows.

samir: after drain, node rebooted (reboot triggered by OOM killer). dmesg shows repeated driver soft hang then Xid 79. snippet: ```Mar 15 02:09:03 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID=2418, GPU 0: Xid 79: GPU has fallen off the bus.```

maya: rolled traffic to v1-small for search-route. error rate dropped to ~0.6% within 6m. latency improved but cost increased. customers on strict SLA affected less now.

ops-robot: note: tp4-node-08 container restarts: 15 restarts since 2026-03-15T02:05:00Z.

dasha: gathering metrics: request p95, error rate, GPU driver versions. will attach to incident doc. please paste any kernel traces here.

ashwin: next steps: - collect full `nvidia-bug-report.sh` from node-08 - escalate to drivers team if Xid 79 persists - consider taking node out of rotation until firmware/driver verified - re-evaluate NCCL/tuning (increase `NCCL_IB_TIMEOUT`, enable `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING`)

maya: ran `nvidia-bug-report.sh` and uploaded to /incidents/2790005555/bugreport-node08.tar.gz. also captured `nvtop` snapshot.

eng-runtime-bot: executed restart of affected containers on nodes 09 and 12, no immediate recurrence on 09 after restart. Node-08 continued to show GPU detach events.

samir: handoff to ashwin for next hour — i'm going to investigate model-level batching causes but leaving infra actions with ashwin.

ashwin: acknowledged. i'm primary now. scheduling a short maintenance window to repro on an isolated cluster. If we see same Xid 79 consistently we'll roll driver rollback to previous stable build on a canary node.

lee: support note: notified enterprise-corp and explained mitigations + fallback routing. they requested ETA for full recovery. I'll keep them updated.

dasha: creating incident ticket and filling initial timeline + impact. tagging owners: eng-runtime (maya, samir), eng-sre (ashwin, dasha), drivers (@drivers-oncall).

maya: quick QA: if we can't stabilize multi-gpu, plan is to keep fallback single-gpu models for affected tenants and throttle batch sizes. we should also enable extra logging for KV cache hits to rule out prefix cache causing lockups.

ops-robot: reminder: incident severity remains sev2. escalation policy: if customer-impacting error rate >2% for >30m escalate to sev1. current error rate has dropped below threshold after reroute.

ashwin: small update — canary with older driver (520.xx) on isolated node reproduced Xid 79 under synthetic tp4 workload. collecting full repro logs. If confirmed we'll schedule driver rollback for a small set of nodes.

samir: thanks — i'll draft postmortem template and collect prompt/eval regressions caused by the fallback.

maya: handoff note: ashwin is primary, i'll be offline for 25m but monitoring threads. ping me if we need model rollback.

ashwin: accepted handoff. current status: mitigated for customer-facing routes (reroute + drain), investigating root cause (driver or NVLINK hardware). action items below.

---
Action items (short):
- ashwin: continue repro on canary + decide driver rollback (ETA 2h)
- samir: analyze model batch behavior & batching config changes (ETA 1h)
- dasha: compile incident doc + attach logs (ETA 30m)
- drivers-oncall: triage Xid 79 bugreport (assigned)
- lee: keep enterprise-corp ticket updated

Status: mitigated (fallback/reroute). severity: sev2. next update in 30m or on major new observation.

(reacts: maya :thumbsup:, ashwin :heavy_check_mark:)
